subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 5 2 1 4 7 8 6 5 2 3 9 1 (Right)

How many such odd numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 5 2 1 4 7 8 6 5 2 3 9 1 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Odd — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7a58cb28115f12d4c6847e340432194adae780512913a0f87ccdd19439307f1.png] 

Thus, there is 1 odd number, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
